nuggets.text: Rams coach Jim Mora walked on at Washington as a reserve defensive back before his coaching career.
Rams coach Jim Mora's father, Jim E. Mora, was also an NFL head coach.
Hauss Hejny threw five touchdown passes against Wyoming and also caught a 28-yard pass on a trick play.
RJ Vick caught three touchdown passes, including a 57-yarder, in the Rams' 35-13 Border War win.
Jim Mora's first Rams roster brought in 76 new players, including 41 transfers.
The Rams opened the Jim Mora era in front of a record announced crowd at Canvas Stadium.
Ag Day is the Rams' annual orange out, with throwback orange jerseys honoring the old Colorado A&M Aggies.
The Rams' mascot CAM is named for Colorado A&M, and 26 different Rambouillet sheep have played him since 1947.
A 450-pound bell from CSU's Old Main building rings at the Rams' Canvas Stadium after victories.
The Rams' cannon, nicknamed Comatose, was built in France in 1918 and has been used since 1920.
